newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Motor June sales up 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Motor June sales up 8.3 pct.

text.p: Hyundai Motor Co Ltd , South Korea's largest carmaker, said on Tuesday its vehicles sales in June rose 8.3 percent to 118,764 units from 109,696 units a year earlier.
A Hyundai spokesman said exports soared 42 percent to 61,993 units from 43,609 units.
The spokesman said domestic sales fell 14 percent to 56,771 vehicles from 66,087.
"Our domestic sales were affected by the introduction of Daewoo Motor's new model cars," said the spokesman.
"Exports picked up thanks to our drive to explore relatively new markets, such as Turkey, Greece, Spain and Italy," he said
Hyundai's vehicle sales in the first half of this year totalled 593,989, down from 636,610 a year ago.
In the six-month period, exports amounted to 282,560 vehicles, up from 265,537.
